title.zh: 英伟达暂停向东南亚四国发运服务器
title.en: Nvidia halts server shipments to four Southeast Asian countries

summary.zh: 英伟达已通知戴尔、超微等合作伙伴，暂停向马来西亚、新加坡、泰国和印尼发运服务器，起因是美国收紧针对中国云访问的出口管制；经销商已在寻找数千颗 B300 的买家。
summary.en: Nvidia told partners such as Dell and Supermicro to stop shipping servers to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia after new US export controls targeting Chinese cloud access; dealers are already seeking buyers for thousands of B300 chips.

why.zh: 东南亚数据中心的融资与大单面临风险，算力供应链再受冲击。
why.en: Loans and major deals for Southeast Asian data centers are at risk, another shock to the compute supply chain.

sources.title: Nvidia hits pause on chip shipments to Southeast Asia
Nvidia halts server shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, and Indonesia after tighter US export controls

title.zh: Google DeepMind 发布 Gemini 4 Neon

summary.en: Per Latent Space, Gemini 4 Neon beats Astra and Fable on LiveBench and cuts Theo's TS Rust benchmark runtime by 48.6%.

why.zh: 前沿模型格局再度洗牌，DeepMind 重回第一梯队。
why.en: Reshuffles the frontier-model race and puts DeepMind back among the leaders.

sources.title: [AINews] Gemini 4 Neon marks GDM's full return as a Frontier Lab

title.zh: OpenAI 修正计费错误，GPT-6.2 用户更快触达限额
title.en: OpenAI patches pricing bug; GPT-6.2 users hit limits faster

summary.zh: OpenAI 称计费漏洞导致折扣错误，修复后 Astra 与 Sol 用户触达限额的速度比上周快 40% 和 25%；订阅者获额外一次重置，企业用户年底前免费使用 Fast Mode。OpenAI 还将合并 ChatGPT 的 Chat 与 Work，使用统一用量计量。
summary.en: OpenAI says a billing bug gave GPT-6.2 users incorrect discounts; after the fix Astra and Sol users hit limits 40% and 25% faster. Subscribers get an extra reset and business users free Fast Mode through year-end. OpenAI is also merging Chat and Work with a single usage meter.

why.zh: 直接影响重度用户的实际可用额度。
why.en: Directly changes the usable quota for heavy users.

sources.title: GPT-6.2 Astra users now hit limits 40% faster after OpenAI patched a pricing error
OpenAI says heavy ChatGPT users may hit limits sooner as it merges Chat and Work

title.zh: 微软披露国家级黑客使用 ARTEX AI 框架自动化攻击
title.en: Microsoft details state-backed hackers' use of ARTEX AI attack framework

summary.zh: 微软公开了 ARTEX 的技术架构：该框架自 2026 年 7 月起被广泛使用，以专用 Agent 几乎无人工参与地发动网络攻击，中国、朝鲜的国家级团体及犯罪组织均在使用。微软建议用蜜罐和伪造成功信号等欺骗手段防御。
summary.en: Microsoft published the architecture of ARTEX, in wide use since July 2026, which runs cyberattacks with specialized agents and little human involvement; groups from China and North Korea and criminal organizations use it. Microsoft recommends deception defenses such as honeypots and faked success signals.

why.zh: AI 驱动的自动化攻击已进入实战，防守方需要调整策略。
why.en: AI-driven automated attacks are now operational, forcing defenders to adapt.

sources.title: Microsoft details how state-backed hackers use the ARTEX AI framework to automate cyberattacks

title.zh: Aaronson：AI 能写出黎曼猜想证明这件事本身更重要
title.en: Aaronson: that AI can produce a Riemann proof matters more than the proof

summary.zh: 复杂性理论学者 Scott Aaronson 认为 AI 近期的数学突破影响远超学术界，并称他几乎确信各 AI 实验室手握密码学方面的“重磅成果”。同期 AINews 汇总了 Erdős 问题、矩阵乘法等新结果。
summary.en: Scott Aaronson argues AI's recent math breakthroughs matter far beyond academia and is 'virtually certain' labs are sitting on cryptography 'bombshells'. AINews separately rounds up new results from Erdős problems to matrix multiplication bounds.

why.zh: 数学证明产出速度已超过人类阅读速度，影响科研与密码学安全。
why.en: Proofs now arrive faster than humans can read them, with implications for research and cryptography.

sources.title: Former OpenAI researcher says the Riemann proof matters less than the fact that an AI system can produce it
[AINews] Math Proofs Are Landing Faster Than We Can Read Them

title.zh: 42 个州检察长阻止 Character.AI 拍卖用户聊天记录
title.en: 42 state AGs move to block Character.AI's sale of user chats

summary.zh: 在 Character.AI 的破产重组程序中，其出售方案包含超过 2100 万美国账户的私人聊天记录，其中 210 万为未成年人账户，42 个州检察长联合反对。
summary.en: In Character.AI's Chapter 11 sale, data from more than 21 million US accounts, including 2.1 million registered to minors, is on the block; 42 state attorneys general are challenging it.

why.zh: 可能成为 AI 公司破产时用户数据处置的先例。
why.en: May set a precedent for how user data is handled when AI firms go bankrupt.

sources.title: 42 state AGs are trying to stop Character.AI from selling users’ chats
Character.AI’s plan to auction off users’ private chats challenged by state AGs

title.zh: 亚马逊与 Meta 洽谈解除对 AI 购物 Agent Muse 的封锁
title.en: Amazon and Meta in talks to lift block on AI shopping agent Muse

summary.zh: 据报道，亚马逊正与 Meta 讨论让 Muse 重回其平台，封锁已持续两个月，分歧在于广告收入和搜索结果控制权；亚马逊广告业务年收入 686 亿美元，Muse 占 Agent 购物订单的 51%。
summary.en: Amazon and Meta are reportedly discussing ending a two-month block of Muse, stuck on ad revenue and control of search results. Amazon's ad business earns $68.6B a year and Muse commands 51% of agentic shopping orders.

why.zh: 决定 Agent 购物能否进入主流电商平台。
why.en: Shapes whether agentic shopping can run on the major e-commerce platforms.

sources.title: Amazon and Meta are in talks to end the block on Meta's AI shopping agent Muse in Amazon's online store.
Amazon and Meta reportedly in talks to lift blockade on AI agent Muse
Amazon is reportedly in talks to end Muse AI shopping block

title.zh: 出口管制与反蒸馏措施拖慢中国 AI 实验室
title.en: Export controls and anti-distillation measures slow Chinese AI labs

summary.zh: 据报道，芯片限制、反蒸馏措施和海外英伟达硬件减少正给 DeepSeek、月之暗面和阿里带来压力，DeepSeek 内部估计已落后美国模型最多九个月；Z.AI 与月之暗面也推迟旗舰模型并寻找新的训练数据来源。
summary.en: Chip restrictions, anti-distillation measures and shrinking Nvidia access are pressuring DeepSeek, Moonshot and Alibaba; DeepSeek estimates it is up to nine months behind US models. Z.AI and Moonshot are delaying flagship models and seeking new training data.

why.zh: 中美 AI 差距可能在拉大。
why.en: The US-China AI gap may be widening.

sources.title: US chip-access curbs and anti-distillation measures are reportedly already slowing Chinese AI labs
After OpenAI and Anthropic shut the door on their data, a Chinese AI developer is turning to Google and Meta instead

title.zh: FCC 批准 SpaceX 部署至多 100 万颗 Starmind 太空数据中心卫星
title.en: FCC clears SpaceX for up to 1 million Starmind orbital data-center satellites

summary.zh: FCC 授权 SpaceX 部署至多 100 万颗搭载 AI 芯片的 Starmind 卫星，首批发射目标为 2027 年，2040 年前全部运行；BCG 估计成本仍远高于地面数据中心。
summary.en: The FCC authorized up to 1 million AI-chip satellites under SpaceX's Starmind initiative, first launches targeted for 2027 and full operation by 2040; BCG estimates costs remain well above ground-based data centers.

why.zh: 首个监管批准，太空算力从设想走向落地。
why.en: The first regulatory approval, moving orbital compute from idea toward reality.

sources.title: FCC clears SpaceX to deploy up to 1 million Starmind satellites for orbital AI data centers by 2040
FCC signs off on SpaceX’s plan to put up to 1 million data center satellites into space

title.zh: OpenAI 测试“Private Inference”，承诺无法查看企业数据
title.en: OpenAI tests 'Private Inference' so it cannot see enterprise data

summary.zh: OpenAI 正在测试 Private Inference，让企业在其最强模型上运行查询而 OpenAI 无法访问数据。
summary.en: OpenAI is testing Private Inference, letting companies run queries on its most powerful models without OpenAI being able to access the data.

why.zh: 可能扫除企业处理敏感业务的一大障碍。
why.en: Could remove a key barrier to enterprise use for sensitive work.

sources.title: OpenAI wants companies to trust it with sensitive work by promising not to look at their data

title.zh: Amodei：把治理权交给 AI 是个坏主意
title.en: Amodei: handing governance to AI is a bad idea

summary.zh: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei 反驳 Axios 关于部分员工相信人类将把权力交给超级智能的报道，称“把治理交给 AI 是坏主意”，并否认竞争对手关于他主张放弃人类控制的指责。
summary.en: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei pushed back on an Axios report that some employees expect humanity to hand power to superintelligence, saying turning over governance to AI is a bad idea, and rejected rivals' accusations.

why.zh: 头部实验室负责人对 AI 治理立场的公开表态。
why.en: A public stance on AI governance from a leading lab's CEO.

sources.title: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei says letting AI govern society would be "a bad idea"
Anthropic’s Dario Amodei calls accusations of surrendering human control to AI ‘absurd’

title.zh: 标普考虑下调英伟达信用评级
title.en: S&P considers downgrading Nvidia's credit rating

summary.zh: 标普可能把英伟达评级下调至 AA-（第四高），理由涉及公司治理与“关键人”风险。
summary.en: S&P may cut Nvidia's rating to AA-, the fourth-highest, citing governance and 'key man' risks.

why.zh: AI 算力龙头的财务与治理风险受到评级机构关注。
why.en: Rating agencies are flagging financial and governance risk at the AI compute leader.

sources.title: S&P considers Nvidia credit downgrade over governance and ‘key man’ risks
